name: multi-agent-folder-cleanup
description: Audit, plan, and safely reorganize shared project folders or multi-project portfolios with connector evidence validation and verified execution boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Audit project folders and portfolios safely
interface.longDescription: Find conflicting authority, cross-project search contamination, stale indexes, missing entrypoints, documentary-only claims, duplicate or pointer records, generated noise, and unsafe move or connector-edit conditions. Plan or execute only an explicitly approved mutation list and verify the result.
capabilities: Verified move, record-only, and additive-intake checks
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $multi-agent-folder-cleanup to audit this shared project folder or portfolio and explain what is authoritative, stale, operationally verified, incoming, or ambiguous.
